note: GoBanana visual styles (docs/styles). Read by banana-server lib/styles (a mirror of this file). Genres: mobile, web, showcase, deck, brand.

styles.name: Dark luminous
styles.definition: A near-black screen where one glow, gradient bloom, lit object or AI orb is the only light.
signals: Near-black ground (lightness under about 12%).
One luminous focal area: a glow rim, a gradient bloom, a lit object or an orb.
Thin, small grey labels around it.
A single accent hue (lime, orange, electric blue), never a rainbow.
styles.tellApart: Look for the light. Dark luminous has a glow, bloom or orb you notice first; dark quiet matte has none, only surface tone steps and one hairline.
styles.great: One focal glow and everything else quiet, real data and tight type. An AI orb, when there is one, has a real state (listening, thinking) and is the only effect.
styles.cheap: Glow everywhere, neon on every control, purple to blue on every surface, glow used as a background wash, a generic purple blob with sparkle icons.

mobile: near black app ui neon accent
web: dark web app ui gradient glow

styles.name: Dark quiet matte
styles.definition: A flat, matte, near-black product UI with no glow, built from tone steps and hairlines.
signals: Matte black or charcoal ground.
Surfaces differ by 2 to 4% lightness; no glow, no bloom.
1 px borders and dividers.
One small accent: a green or blue dot, a status chip.
styles.tellApart: No light source at all. If something glows or blooms it is dark luminous; if the frame is about information load more than surface, it is data dense dashboard.
styles.great: Reads as a real tool: dense but calm tables, thin charts, one accent, every state resolved.
styles.cheap: A black skin on a light layout, grey on grey with no hierarchy, default chart colours on black.

web: dark mode minimal web app ui

styles.name: Data dense dashboard
styles.definition: Many real numbers, tables and thin charts in one calm grid, with one figure that wins.
signals: 4 or more widgets in view.
Thin bar and line charts, small multiples.
Status chips and a table set in small type.
One hero metric among the small ones.
styles.tellApart: Count the figures. Data dense has many figures with one dominant; hero numeral has one figure and little else.
styles.great: Real, believable data, a quiet palette, aligned columns and one number that wins.
styles.cheap: Rainbow pies, every card a different chart type, lorem numbers, icon rows, four equal KPI cards.

styles.name: Glass and frosted
styles.definition: Frosted translucent panels layered over a colourful or photographic backdrop.
signals: A blurred backdrop showing through a panel.
A soft white edge highlight on the panel.
Layered cards with soft shadow.
A landscape or colour field behind a window.
styles.tellApart: Look at the material. Glass is a flat translucent sheet; soft 3D is a lit object with volume and a cast shadow.
styles.great: Glass used lightly over one rich backdrop, with the text still sharp and readable.
styles.cheap: Everything blurred, glass on a flat grey ground (it has nothing to show), five stacked glass cards.

styles.name: Soft 3D objects
styles.definition: UI widgets and cards rendered as lit, glossy or tactile 3D objects, in the Spline and Blender manner.
signals: A rounded squircle slab with visible thickness.
Glossy gradient glass, rubber or clay material.
A cast shadow on a light or dark floor.
One object per frame.
styles.tellApart: Look at scale. Soft 3D is an object inside a UI or on a slide; WebGL 3D scene is a whole navigable world that is the page.
styles.great: One object, believable light, a real number or label on it.
styles.cheap: Stock 3D people, plastic icon packs, floating coins and padlocks.

styles.name: Vivid gradient field
styles.definition: A saturated, smooth gradient or mesh is the main surface of the screen or slide.
signals: A full-bleed colour gradient or mesh.
Blue to violet or orange to red, saturated.
White type on the gradient.
Often one glassy card on top.
styles.tellApart: Look at the area. Vivid gradient puts colour across most of the frame; dark luminous keeps the glow to one spot on black.
styles.great: One hue family with luminous depth, and the gradient has a job (a mood, a plan colour, a state).
styles.cheap: The default AI look: an indigo to violet gradient, gradient text, a gradient button on a gradient card.

styles.name: Photographic hero
styles.definition: A real photograph is the material: a phone in a hand, a window over a mountain, a face, or a product family lit like a studio shot.
signals: A full-bleed photo, or a device held in a photographed hand.
A UI window over a landscape.
Natural or studio light with shallow depth.
Type laid over the photo; or 3 to 6 packs in one palette on a seamless backdrop.
styles.tellApart: Ask what leads. In photographic hero the picture leads; in editorial serif the type leads and the photo supports.
styles.great: One photo with a clear subject and a UI or type that fits it; a packaging family with one system, lit to feel real.
styles.cheap: Stock handshakes, a lone laptop with nothing on screen, a photo under a coloured wash, a shelf of generic bottles, a flat label pasted on a bottle render.

styles.name: Big type display
styles.definition: One word or short line set huge, in a condensed, bold or oversized sans, is the image.
signals: Letters cropped by the frame or filling it.
One or two words ("KPI REPORT", "WAKE UP WORLD").
Tight leading.
Small grey meta text in a corner.
styles.tellApart: Look at the letterform. Big type is a heavy or condensed sans shouting; editorial serif is a refined serif speaking. A huge figure with data meaning is hero numeral.
styles.great: One idea, a real typeface with character, a calm margin.
styles.cheap: A big default sans plus three bullets, mixed display fonts, huge text that wraps badly.

styles.name: Hero numeral
styles.definition: One huge figure carries the screen or slide, with small grey labels around it.
signals: A number at 5 to 10 times the label size ("$63,000", "13,143").
A thin line or bar chart at most.
Large empty space around the figure.
One supporting label row.
styles.tellApart: Look at the content. Hero numeral is a number with data meaning; big type is words. Many figures with one dominant is data dense dashboard.
styles.great: One real-feeling figure with its unit, one supporting label row, nothing else.
styles.cheap: Four equal KPI cards, icons beside each number, a donut with a number in the middle.

styles.name: Editorial serif
styles.definition: A well cut serif and a calm grid, the way a magazine or annual report is set.
signals: A serif display line ("Pick your Plan").
Pull quotes and small caps labels.
Generous margins on a visible grid.
Muted paper or cream grounds.
styles.tellApart: Look at the voice. Editorial has a serif as its voice; minimal mono light is sans or mono and almost silent. If the photo leads, it is photographic hero.
styles.great: A serif with real contrast and optical spacing, a visible grid and one image.
styles.cheap: Georgia or Times as the only serif, a serif heading on a gradient SaaS page.

styles.name: Minimal mono light
styles.definition: A quiet light product UI in one tone with one accent and tight, real type.
signals: White or light grey ground with black text.
One accent colour.
Thin dividers, no shadows to speak of.
One screen shown clean.
styles.tellApart: Look at the ground. Minimal mono is neutral with an accent; flat colour field commits the whole frame to one bold colour.
styles.great: Shipped-grade: real data, tight type, every state resolved.
styles.cheap: A pastel concept with stock illustration and lorem, or an empty wireframe.

styles.name: Flat colour field
styles.definition: Flat, shadowless blocks of solid colour, with one bold ground and no gradients.
signals: A solid saturated ground (lime, orange, red, cobalt, green).
Flat shapes with hard edges.
No shadow, no blur.
Black or white type.
styles.tellApart: Look at the energy. Flat colour field is confident and static; playful adds character, bounce and surprise.
styles.great: 2 or 3 flat colours and a strong type or mark.
styles.cheap: Six pastels, drop shadows creeping in, flat stock illustration characters.

styles.name: Retro, raw, pixel and halftone
styles.definition: A deliberate older or rougher look: halftone, dither, pixel, Art Deco, vintage badge, or raw brutalist type and grid.
signals: Dot-screen or dither texture, or a pixelated image.
Deco display letters or a round badge, limited ink colours, paper grain.
Or raw: system or mono type used loud, a visible grid, harsh contrast.
Cut-off or overlapping text, visible table lines, noise or glitch.
styles.tellApart: Look at the cue. Retro quotes an older medium (print, pixel, CRT) or a raw unstyled one; a type-led brand system is about the mark and its system, any era.
styles.great: Texture as a second voice on one element (the "BUDGET" card), not a wash; raw on purpose and exact underneath (alignment is tight).
styles.cheap: A retro filter on everything, an 80s neon grid, fake worn textures; or just messy, or neo-brutalist cards with thick black borders and a pastel shadow.

styles.name: Playful, too fun
styles.definition: Character, colour and bounce first: the page is a toy.
signals: Big rounded or bubble letters.
A character or mascot.
Saturated colour blocks and tilted elements.
Hand-drawn or toy-like 3D props.
styles.tellApart: Look at the feel. Playful is loud and energetic; illustrative handmade can be calm, quiet or literary. A static bold ground with no character is flat colour field.
styles.great: Joyful and still clear: one idea, tight craft, content still readable.
styles.cheap: Clip-art mascots, rainbow everything, comic fonts, stock cartoon people.

styles.name: Illustrative and handmade
styles.definition: Drawn, printed or collaged artwork carries the identity.
signals: A visible line or brush.
A limited ink palette.
Flat figures with texture, or botanical and folk drawing.
A collage of cut shapes.
styles.tellApart: Look at the feel. Illustrative can be calm, quiet or literary; playful is loud and energetic.
styles.great: A recognisable hand and a system: one line weight, one palette.
styles.cheap: Flat vector stock people, Corporate Memphis, AI illustration with six-fingered hands.

styles.name: WebGL 3D scene
styles.definition: A real-time 3D object or world is the website itself, moved by scroll or mouse.
signals: A rendered object centred in the frame (a helmet, an igloo, a planet, an isometric town).
Depth and light effects.
Sparse UI chrome on top.
Often a loader or an "enter" button.
styles.tellApart: Look at scale. WebGL 3D scene is a whole world that is the page; soft 3D is an object inside a UI.
styles.great: A bespoke object, one clear interaction, fast load.
styles.cheap: A stock 3D blob over a SaaS headline, a heavy scene with no content, a model that is not the product.

styles.name: Motion first
styles.definition: The design is the movement (scrub, drag, morph, kinetic type), and the still is the least of it.
signals: A slider, dial or scrubber with a visible state.
Motion blur or a trail, or a mid-transition frame.
A before and after pair.
A "0:07" or 60fps mark on the shot.
styles.tellApart: Look at the carrier. Motion first is a UI gesture or a type move; WebGL 3D is a rendered world.
styles.great: One rehearsed gesture with a clear start and end state and a reason.
styles.cheap: Fades on everything, bouncing icons, parallax for its own sake.

styles.name: Type-led brand system
styles.definition: An identity built from one mark, one move and a pattern, applied to posters, signage and sets.
signals: A wordmark or monogram.
A repeating pattern or wall of the wordmark.
One ground and one accent.
The mark on a banner, bag or billboard; a poster set in one palette.
styles.tellApart: Look at the scope. A type-led brand system is the mark and its system across things; flat colour field is the surface treatment.
styles.great: One idea carried through many applications.
styles.cheap: A logo floating on a mockup, twelve logo options on a page, a guideline template.

styles.name: Gulf and Arabic first
styles.definition: Arabic type and Gulf craft lead the layout, right to left, with pattern or material taken from a named Gulf craft.
signals: Arabic display, Naskh or Kufic type set large.
A right to left layout with mirrored flow.
Sadu, Talli, Najdi or roshan pattern used as a band or field, not a stamp.
Warm sand, indigo, saffron and black grounds.
styles.tellApart: Look at direction and script. Gulf and Arabic first changes the layout and the script; a brand system only changes the mark.
styles.great: Credits the craft, uses its real grammar, sets Arabic by a native eye and mirrors the layout.
styles.cheap: A mosque silhouette, gold crescents, a pattern as wallpaper, Arabic letters in a Latin layout, fake letterforms.
